name: Tarok Danish
description: Danish Tarok (Grosstarock) is a three-player trick-taking game using a 78-card tarot deck (21 trumps, Fool, 4 suits of 14). Primary objective: win the last trick with the lowest trump (trump 1) or a King. Secondary: win tricks and capture counting cards. Alliances form during play. Each player gets 25 cards (dealer gets 3 extra then discards to 25). Declarations at start: trump holdings, matadors (Fool, lowest trump, 21), court combinations. Two pots (king pot, lowest-trump pot). Card values: 4 for trump 21, lowest trump, Fool, Kings; 3 Queens; 2 Knights; 1 Jacks. Closely related to German Grosstarock; survives mainly in Denmark.

history.origins: Danish Tarok is the surviving form of German Grosstarock (Grosstarok), introduced in Germany around 1720; now played mainly in Denmark. 78-card tarot, 3 players, lowest-trump/King ultimo and two pots.
timeline: 20th century: Survives in Denmark as Danish Tarok

setup.players: Three active players. With four people, the player opposite the dealer sits out and does not play; that player shuffles the spare pack. Play is counter-clockwise; the player to the dealer's right leads to the first trick.
setup.dealing: 25 cards each; dealer gets 3 extra then discards to 25

rules.objective: Primary: win the last trick with the lowest trump (trump 1) or a King. Secondary: win tricks and capture counting cards. Two pots (king pot, lowest-trump pot).
rules.gameplay: Deal 25 cards each (dealer gets 3 extra then discards to 25). Declarations at start: trump holdings, matadors (Fool, lowest trump, 21), court combinations. Follow suit; must play trump if cannot follow. Card values: 4 for trump 21, lowest trump, Fool, Kings; 3 Queens; 2 Knights; 1 Jacks. Alliances form during play.
keyRules: Declarations: trump holdings, matadors, court combinations
Two pots: king pot, lowest-trump pot

variations.name: Fool never discard
variations.description: Some play that the Fool can never be discarded; dealer cannot play for Tout if holding the Fool.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Rule change only; no engine constant overrides documented.

variations.name: Trump discard reveal
variations.description: Some play that if the dealer discards trumps, when he shows void of trumps he must if asked declare how many trumps he discarded.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Rule change only; no engine constant overrides documented.

variations.name: Historic lowest-trump discard
variations.description: Formerly it was legal to discard the lowest trump (but not Mondo) to create a void in trumps; modern clubs use the rule that Ultimo cards can never be discarded.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Rule change only; no engine constant overrides documented.

scoring.winCondition: Win the last trick (primary); win last trick with Pagat or a King (Ultimo) for bonus; avoid playing Pagat or King to last trick and losing (Bagud penalty). Two pots (king pot, pagat pot) awarded on Ultimo.
